q001.answer: A woman who has completed 21 years of age, meaning those born before September 15, 2002, can apply for the Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam. [1][2] Families applying must satisfy three economic criteria: earning an annual income below Rs. 2.5 lakhs, holding less than five acres of Wetland or less than ten acres of Dryland, and consuming less than 3600 units of electricity per year for domestic use. [3][4] Applicants should only apply at the Application Registration camps pertaining to the fair price shop where their family card is registered. [1][2]
